name: Exercise heart rate
rangeNote: Your maximum heart rate is roughly 208 − 0.7 × your age (it varies by about 10 beats between people). Moderate exercise is about 64–76 % of that, vigorous about 77–95 %. The same workout at a lower heart rate over months usually means better fitness.
summary: The average heart rate during a workout, from a watch or chest strap. Compared over months for the same kind of workout, it shows how your fitness is changing.

high.meaning: A higher heart rate for the same effort than usual can come from heat, dehydration, poor sleep, illness or a harder session. Chest pain, fainting or a racing irregular pulse during exercise need a doctor straight away.

low.meaning: A lower heart rate for the same workout over time usually reflects better fitness. Some heart medicines also limit it.

sources.title: American College of Sports Medicine position stand. Quantity and quality of exercise for developing and maintaining cardiorespiratory, musculoskeletal, and neuromotor fitness in apparently healthy adults: guidance for prescribing exercise
